title: Cubic and Cube Root Functions
seo_title: Algebra II Cubic and Cube Root Functions Worksheets (TEKS 2A.6A, 2A.6B)
domain: Cubic, Cube Root, Absolute Value, and Rational Functions, Equations, and Inequalities
standard_text: 2A.6A analyze the effect on the graphs of f(x) = x^3 and f(x) = ∛x when f(x) is replaced by af(x), f(bx), f(x − c), and f(x) + d for specific positive and negative real values of a, b, c, and d; 2A.6B solve cube root equations that have real roots
meta_desc: Free Algebra II worksheets for Texas TEKS 2A.6A and 2A.6B: transformations of x³ and ∛x, horizontal stretches and reflections, and solving cube root equations. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: Undo a cube root by cubing both sides.
key_sub: (x − c)³ + d moves the center to (c, d).
body_html:
How to think about it

  • g(x) = a(b(x − c))3 + d and g(x) = a∛(b(x − c)) + d move the center point (0, 0) to (c, d).
  • a stretches or shrinks vertically and a negative a reflects over the x-axis.
  • bx divides every x-coordinate by b.
  • To solve a cube root equation, get the root alone and cube both sides. Cube roots of negative numbers are real: ∛(−8) = −2.

Examples

Example

∛(2x + 3) = −3

2x + 3 = −27

Answer: x = −15

Example

g(x) = (x + 2)3 − 1

Left 2, down 1

Answer: Center point (−2, −1)

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Shifting the wrong way(x + 2)3 moves left 2.
Squaring instead of cubingUndo ∛ by cubing.
Saying a negative has no cube root∛(−27) = −3.
